questions.question: What does God say about a house humans might build for him in Isaiah 66?
options: He greatly delights to dwell within the courts of the temple that they have raised up
He turns himself away and wholly rejects all the worship of those who draw near to him
Heaven is his throne and the earth his footstool; what house will you build for me?
He has great need of the house, so that all of his people may bring to him their gifts
questions.answer: Heaven is his throne and the earth his footstool; what house will you build for me?

questions.question: Whom does God say he will look to in Isaiah 66?
options: The humble and contrite in spirit, who trembles at his word
The mighty and the proud who build up very great altars
The wise who fully understand each and every one of his ways
The wealthy who bring to him the very finest of all offerings
questions.answer: The humble and contrite in spirit, who trembles at his word

questions.question: Isaiah 66 says God will comfort his people as one whom his mother comforts.
Heaven is my _____, and the earth is my footstool.
As one whom his mother comforts, so I will _____ you, says the LORD.
